# tebib_vm (Resource)

A virtual machine, created from an image.

In place: `instance_type` (the VM is stopped, resized, then started again if `power_state` is `running`), `security_group_ids`, `power_state`, a larger `root_disk_gib`, `description` and `tags`. Any other change replaces the VM.

Deleting the VM deletes its boot volume and the volumes marked `delete_on_termination`; other volumes are detached and kept, and its public IP stays in the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tebib_images" "ubuntu" {
  os_family = "ubuntu"
}

resource "tebib_vm" "web" {
  name               = "web-1"
  image              = data.tebib_images.ubuntu.names[0]
  instance_type      = "b1.small"
  subnet_id          = tebib_subnet.web.id
  security_group_ids = [tebib_security_group.web.id]
  ssh_key_ids        = [tebib_ssh_key.me.id]
  root_disk_gib      = 20

  user_data = <<-EOT
    #cloud-config
    packages: [nginx]
  EOT

  timeouts {
    create = "20m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Image name, e.g. `ubuntu-24.04` (see the `tebib_images` data source). Changing it replaces the VM.
- `instance_type` (String) Instance type, e.g. `b1.small` (see the `tebib_instance_types` data source). Changing it stops, resizes and restarts the VM.
- `name` (String) Name, unique among the project's VMs. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname. Default: the name. Changing it replaces the VM.
- `power_state` (String) Wanted power state: `running` or `stopped`. Default: `running`. A shutdown from inside the guest leaves this `running`; apply again to start it.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `root_disk_gib` (Number) Boot volume size in GiB. Default: the image's minimum. Growing it resizes the boot volume in place (grow the filesystem in the guest); a smaller value replaces the VM.
- `security_group_ids` (Set of String) Security groups of the VM's network interface (all of them), from the subnet's VPC. Default: the VPC's default group. Changes apply in place.
- `ssh_key_ids` (Set of String) SSH keys to install for the image's default user. They are copied at creation: changing them replaces the VM.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet ID. Default: the project's default subnet. Changing it replaces the VM.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_data` (String) cloud-init user data (`#cloud-config ...`), read on first boot. The API doesn't return it, so it is not refreshed. Changing it replaces the VM.

### Read-Only

- `boot_volume_id` (String) Boot volume ID (`vol-...`).
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `current_power_state` (String) Power state the platform last saw.
- `guest_agent` (Boolean) Whether the guest agent is answering.
- `id` (String) VM ID (`vm-...`).
- `ipv4_address` (String) Primary private IPv4 address.
- `ipv6_address` (String) IPv6 address (routed, public).
- `memory_mib` (Number) Memory of the instance type, in MiB.
- `restart_required` (Boolean) Whether a change waits for a restart.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state: `active` once ready (or `error`).
- `status_message` (String) What the platform last said about the resource.
- `trn` (String) TebibHost resource name (TRN), for IAM policies.
- `vcpus` (Number) vCPUs of the instance type.

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The API never returns user_data: after an import, add it to
# lifecycle { ignore_changes = [user_data] } or the VM is replaced.
tofu import tebib_vm.web vm-abc123
```
